title: Long-term proton pump inhibitor (PPI) use and the development of gastric pre-malignant lesions
authors: Song H, Zhu J, Lu D
population: 7 randomised trials of PPI maintenance for 6 months or longer in adults, with gastric biopsy, searched to August 2013
funder: Not read: the PubMed Central record holds the abstract and a PDF only, and the Cochrane Library page refused access.
result: Corpus atrophy OR 1.50 (95% CI 0.59 to 3.80; 4 trials, 1070 participants; low quality); corpus intestinal metaplasia OR 1.46 (0.43 to 5.03; 5 trials, 1408 participants; low quality); diffuse ECL-cell hyperplasia OR 5.01 (1.54 to 16.26; very low quality) and linear or micronodular ECL-cell hyperplasia OR 3.98 (1.31 to 12.16; low quality; 6 trials, 1705 participants). No dysplastic or neoplastic change was observed. Four trials had high and three unclear risk of bias.
